—Our world shall not perish. Not today, not ever.

200011.label: l_9011
200011.name: Spring Fashion Festa Medal
200011.desc: Despite twists and turns, long last are wishes granted. Amidst flowing light, colorfully is the night painted.

200021.label: l_9021
200021.name: Wings of Holy Light Medal
200021.desc:
A medal awarded by the Sardegnia League. It commemorates their victory against the immensely powerful MECHArbiter.
—What awaits us outside the cage is hope and glory.

200031.condition: Collect 8 commemorative stickers from Letters from Valley Hospital
200031.label: l_9031
200031.name: Valley Hospital Investigation Medal
200031.desc: Congratulations! You uncovered Valley Hospital's secrets and reached the best ending. Did you have fun?

200041.condition: Collect 8 stickers in Toward Tulipa's Seas.
200041.label: l_9041
200041.name: Tulipa Commemorative Medal
200041.desc:
A medal from the Kingdom of Tulipa. It commemorates the defense of their country. 
—A new age of unity has begun.

200051.explain1: A Rose on the High Tower
200051.condition: Collect 8 stickers in A Rose on the High Tower.
200051.label: l_9051
200051.name: A Rose on the High Tower Medal
200051.desc:
The high tower crumbles, yet the rose rises from its ruins.
Though this story has its ups and downs, the ending is a satisfactory one. Congratulations are in order.

200061.condition: Collect 7 stickers in Midsummer Returns: The Villa Reconstruction.
200061.label: l_9061
200061.name: The Villa Reconstruction Medal
200061.desc: Sandy beaches, warm sunshine, breezy AC, and refreshing drinks – enjoy this villa vacation on a resort island to its fullest!

200071.condition: Collect 8 stickers in The Neon City Investigator.
200071.label: l_9071
200071.name: Neon City Investigator's Medal
200071.desc: You are the sharpest investigator in Neon City. You've left footprints in many places and solved numerous mysteries with your own hands. Congratulations!

200081.condition: Collect 8 stickers in The Secrets of the Abyss
200081.label: l_9081
200081.name: Secrets of the Abyss Medal
200081.desc:
You brought Aberrinth's secrets to light and thwarted the Calamitous One's evil plans. Did you enjoy the journey, our esteemed Commander? 

– Signed, the Port Virtual Reality Project 2.0 Production Committee

200091.condition: Collect 8 stickers in A Dance for Amahara Above.
200091.label: l_9091
200091.name: Sky Realm Amahara Medal
200091.desc:
"The Sky Realm – it formeth a wall against the world beyond; and thus is the domain within it defined – Amahara. Even should the earth collapse and the mountains crumble, a great disaster is inevitable. The Sky Realm of Amahara, forevermore must it last." 
–Welcome to the Sky Realm of Amahara.

200101.condition: Collect 8 stickers in Tempesta and Islas de Libertád.
200101.label: l_9101
200101.name: Islas de Libertád Medal
200101.desc:
Islas de Libertád – a free place where seekers of liberty may find it.
If it is freedom you desire, Libertypolis welcomes you.

200111.condition: Collect 8 stickers in A Note Through the Firmament.
200111.label: l_9111
200111.name: Star of the Firmament Medal
200111.desc:
A medal based on the Anchorage National Observatory.
——You peeled back the Veil and traversed the firmament.
——The past and the present are connected in this moment.
——A new era has begun.

200121.condition: Collect 8 stickers in the Light & Shadow Fashion Shoot! event.
200121.label: l_9121
200121.name: Fashion Shoot Medal
200121.desc:
Power up the fashion radar and switch into photo gear! Close the shutter and capture some trendy moments! 
——You are today's fashion chronicler!

200131.condition: Collect 8 stickers in the Spring Auction Adventure event.
200131.label: l_9131
200131.name: Spring Auction Medal
200131.desc:
This warm, masterfully cut jade rests in its case, its faint aroma filling the whole garden. All these lucky encounters are merely waiting for your arrival. 
Since you've come here, surely you must have a discerning eye for good jade?

200141.condition: Collect 8 stickers in the Springtide Inn Online event.
200141.label: l_9141
200141.name: Springtide Inn Medal
200141.desc:
Golden cups overflow, the spring breeze intoxicating. Auspicious days beckoning good fortune are ahead.
The inn is now yours to manage. Relish the excitement and joy of the moment.

200151.condition: Collect 8 stickers in The Vagabond's Recruitment Plan event.
200151.label: l_9151
200151.name: Vagabond City Medal
200151.desc:
Neon signs flash above, a rainbow road flows below. Oh, vagabond souls wandering through the sleepless streets, feel the rhythm and melody of the night.
Welcome to Thorn City!

200161.condition: Collect 8 stickers in Alliance Before the Hagiobull.
200161.label: l_9161
200161.name: Hagiobull Alliance Medal
200161.desc:
A commemorative medal bestowed by the Holy Unitas Empire, celebrating the great triumph over the netherworld.
May providence witness this enduring alliance.
